name: rag_service_info
description: Retrieves detailed information about one or more services based on the user's query.

query.description: The service or category for which detailed information is being queried. This can refer to one or more services.

name: rag_product_info
description: Retrieves detailed information about one or more products based on the user's query.

query.description: The product or item for which detailed information is being queried. This can refer to one or more products.

name: rag_doctor_info
description: Retrieves detailed information about one or more doctors based on the user's query.

query.description: The name or specialty of the doctor the user is looking for. This can refer to one or more doctors.

name: qa_medical
description: Answers medical-related questions based on the user's query.

query.description: The medical-related question the user is asking.

name: qa_symptom
description: Answers questions related to symptoms based on the user's query.

query.description: The symptom or condition the user is asking about.

name: book_appointment
description: Books an appointment for a user with specified details.

name.description: The name of the person booking the appointment.

phone.description: The phone number of the person booking the appointment.

date.description: The date for the appointment in YYYY-MM-DD format.

time.description: The time for the appointment in HH:MM format.

specialty.description: The specialty or type of service for which the appointment is being booked.
